findings.detail: v7 preserves process.pid as the start_new_session process-group identity before post-Popen observations and when getpgid reports the parent already reaped. The lifecycle control receipt and mocked interrupt path both pass; this closes the v6 descendant-group cleanup gap within the tested lifecycle.

The actual v7 writer output, including root/child terminal markers, launch timestamps, validation/post-terminal descriptors, native and allocator packet roots, and started/completed counts, is accepted by reducer v3. The reducer output is screen-reduction.v3-screen-adapter with canonical-v1 mapping and adoption disabled.

The v3 reducer validates positive primary samples and paired RSS, but reports useful_signal=false without confidence intervals and keeps adoption_allowed=false. Full follow-up is descriptive confirmation only; the stale v1 all-unity report is not used as final evidence.

The lifecycle receipt covers a live child group and the mock interrupt covers interruption after capture-start during a child. An external interruption before packet-root creation cannot produce a terminal receipt because no packet exists; this audit makes no universal guarantee for that pre-packet interval.
